rounds.text: AB Cotspin India Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading near its 52-week low at just 1% of its range while fundamental performance surges ahead [E5, E68]. Profit growth has been exceptional, featuring a 28% compounded annual growth rate over 5 years, 90% over 3 years, and 33% over the trailing twelve months [E17, E18, E19]. Operating margins have expanded by 7 percentage points over three years to reach 13% by March 2026 [E26], and cash generation is pristine with an operating cash flow of Rs 35 Cr—representing a 2.69x conversion against reported profit [E30, E31]. Furthermore, capital expenditure is nearing completion as evidenced by Capital Work-In-Progress dropping to zero, signaling that new capacity is ready to come online [E36], while insiders demonstrate strong conviction by increasing promoter holding from 34.91% to 52.50% [E37]. Valuation metrics also sit favorably against sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 33.74x versus 47.88x and an EV/EBITDA of 13.82x versus 34.45x [E6, E11], supported by a discounted cash flow intrinsic value estimate of Rs 240 that provides a 16.6% margin of safety over the current Rs 200 market price [E40, E41]. Conceded: [E4, E21, E46, E56, E59].
